name: State-Transition Evidence Contract
summary: Define and enforce separate availability, execution, consequence, readback, outcome, evidence and freshness states so agents cannot promote a lower-layer success into an unverified higher-layer claim.
problem: Agent systems repeatedly collapse configured, executed, accepted, deployed, read-back and outcome states into one success flag, creating false completion and unsafe retries.
coreOutcomes: Evidence identity and freshness attached to consequential state
Retry rules tied to readback rather than missing responses
Product-specific state machines aligned without being collapsed
requirements: A workflow with consequential state transitions
Defined acceptance layers for the work profile
Independent readback where a higher consequence boundary is observable
Tests or validators capable of rejecting invalid promotions
boundaries: The shared vocabulary does not replace product-specific state machines
A lower-layer pass never proves a higher layer
Unknown is not failure and ambiguous is not safe-to-retry
Executor-produced claims do not independently verify the executor
Evidence must be refreshed when its subject changes
